_comment: Copy to your repo root as .prose-lint.json and calibrate on your corpus. Every disable below was earned on a real corpus — start from it, but re-justify each entry for yours. Keep spelling ON; grow allowedWords instead.
_rationale: Disabled rules are markdown-corpus noise classes, not prose defects: layout/whitespace artifacts (WHITESPACE_RULE, SENTENCE_WHITESPACE, COMMA_PARENTHESIS_WHITESPACE, SPACE_BEFORE_PARENTHESIS), fragment-heavy list/table prose (UPPERCASE_SENTENCE_START, EN_UNPAIRED_QUOTES, EN_UNPAIRED_BRACKETS), style advice deliberately ignored (COMMA_COMPOUND_SENTENCE, COMMA_COMPOUND_SENTENCE_2), established technical vocabulary (ID_CASING for 'run id', FILE_EXTENSIONS_CASE for lowercase html/css/js, A_INFINITIVE for 'an install'/'a write'), logical quoting (QUOTATION_MARKS_COMMA), and agreement heuristics that only false-positive on telegraphic technical prose.
